description: Galantamine is a reversible, competitive acetylcholinesterase inhibitor and nicotinic receptor modulator used to improve cognitive function in patients with mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease. It increases the concentration of acetylcholine in the synaptic cleft, thereby enhancing cholinergic neurotransmission. It may modestly improve cognition, function, and behavior, but it does not alter disease progression.

sections.content: Galantamine is a reversible, competitive acetylcholinesterase inhibitor and nicotinic receptor modulator used to improve cognitive function in patients with mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease. It increases the concentration of acetylcholine in the synaptic cleft, thereby enhancing cholinergic neurotransmission. It may modestly improve cognition, function, and behavior, but it does not alter disease progression.
